zh.title: 民航局公布光復節離島航線1072架次 8月24日開放訂位
zh.summary: 光復節連假離島航線提供1072架次 8月24日上午9時開放訂位
body: 交通部民用航空局20日發布新聞稿，宣布115年光復節連假期間（10月24日至26日）將針對澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島管制航線提供共計1,072架次、87,268個座位，航空疏運期定為10月23日至27日共5天。
各航線運能分配為澎湖458架次33,116座位、金門480架次45,072座位、馬祖134架次9,080座位。民航局要求航空公司持續關注訂位狀況，視需求適時增班。
訂位將於8月24日上午9時開放。尖峰時段10月23日至25日由臺灣出發往離島、10月25日至27日離島返回臺灣的機票，將加註「限當日當班次」限制。

en.title: CAA Taiwan announces 1,072 offshore island flights for National Day holiday; booking opens Aug 24
en.summary: CAA Taiwan sets 1,072 flights for Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu; booking opens Aug 24 9am
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on August 20 that for the 2026 National Day holiday (October 24–26), a total of 1,072 flights with 87,268 seats will be allocated across the Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu controlled routes, with the air transport period running from October 23 to 27.
Capacity breakdown: Penghu 458 flights (33,116 seats), Kinmen 480 flights (45,072 seats), Matsu 134 flights (9,080 seats). The CAA has asked airlines to monitor bookings and add flights as needed.

Booking opens at 09:00 on August 24. During peak periods (October 23–25 outbound from Taiwan, October 25–27 inbound to Taiwan), tickets will be endorsed “valid only for the scheduled flight on the day of travel.”
